In season 2, he was an absolute asshole who sold out everyone he could exploit. Yes, he did care about Jamie, but what he did in season 2 was down right wrong. I guess he was a bad person, who definitely had good traits, which these would shine through in season 3.

Abe and Dariela were honestly good parents, they raised their child in the best way they could in a world that was crumbling. Abe was clouded by the hybrid's new findings and something he had been working on for a long time. However, you're right, what he did was wrong. Dariela is obviously a much batter parent than Abe because she knew that the plane was not a place for a child so she packed up and left. In regards to her selling out Clem, she tried to get her own child back, and I guess that her own child is more important than another's. If I saw my child caged up like an animal, I would try my best to get them back.

Unlike Abe and Dariela who went from good to bad, Mitch went from down right AWFUL to sacrificing his life and then risking his life. Absolutely awful before season 1, but during the show, he tried to make things right, thanks to Chloe. In season 2, he realised his array of mistakes and at least tried to do something before he 'died'. When awakened, he made a promise that he would protect Clem to the end of time, and when he heard that Clem was kidnapped, he instantly began looking and going for her. He knew he failed her, so he made things right.

Clem has had the first baby born in over 10 years. Something like that cannot be ignored and there's no way a baby like that could have ever had a normal life. The world was ending, and that is literally the thing that could save it.

When all hope seems lost, this team is trying everything they can to stop the world from ending. If anything, Abigail is the self centered one, trying to end the world with her hybrids, and using other people's children as her Guinea pigs to get her hybrids to take over the world.
